Findings.Title: Ensure MFA is enforced for all users
Findings.FrameworkRef: Microsoft Zero Trust (Identity · MT.1007) + CISA SCuBA M365 Baseline (SCUBA-MS.AAD.3.2v2)
Findings.Result: Conditional Access policy requires MFA for all users.
Findings.Description: MFA blocks credential stuffing and password spray attacks.
Findings.Remediation: 1. Open 'Ensure MFA is enforced for all users' in Microsoft Entra Admin Center (entra.microsoft.com). 2. Apply the change to a pilot group in Report-only mode and verify sign-in/audit logs. 3. Enforce incrementally after impact validation. [Least-Privilege Role: Conditional Access Administrator / Security Administrator]
Findings.RemediationTr: 1. Microsoft Entra Admin Center (entra.microsoft.com) üzerinden 'Ensure MFA is enforced for all users' kontrolünü açın. 2. Değişikliği önce Denetim (Report-only) kipinde pilot gruba uygulayıp oturum açma/olay günlüklerini doğrulayın. 3. Etki analizi sonrası kademeli olarak Zorunlu (Enforce) durumuna geçin. [En Az Ayrıcalıklı Rol: Conditional Access Administrator / Security Administrator]
